get.bucket: A bucket. Fill it at the water.
get.knife: A mushroom knife. The brush cleans.
get.dyeBundle: The four flowers. Take them to the table.
get.splitWood: The branch, in two. Take it to the dirt.
get.stool: A stool. It does nothing. It looks nice.
get.lantern: A lantern. Put it where you like.
get.flowerPot: A pot with a flower. Put it where you like.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Let go of the sword. Holding on to what has passed only weighs you down.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: You defeated the dark. Even victory passes.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Care for the people here. Then the garden opens.

guide.speaker: npc
guide.text: There is nothing left to fight.

guide.speaker: npc
guide.text: Wander. Meaning is found along the way.

gate.speaker: npc
gate.text: Go to the fire in the middle.

after.speaker: npc
after.text: You found it. A place to sit.

after.speaker: npc
after.text: Suffering comes from wanting what doesn't stay. Here, just breathe.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: There is nothing left to fight.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Wander. Meaning is found along the way.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: A hero. How novel. Out of my sun, I was napping.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That branch beside me? Take it. Hold it into my fire and it wakes as a TORCH.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Two hearths in this clearing sit cold. Carry the flame to them.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I own nothing and lack nothing. How much do you carry, hero?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Friend! You look thirsty. Or dry. Either way — opportunity.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Free sample: this BUCKET. Fill it in my pond, just west of the fire.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: A full bucket waters crops and drowns small fires. Endless uses. Costs you nothing. Today only.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Tell your friends. If you find any out there.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The pines sing, but they crowd the verse.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: This GREAT AXE fells even LIVING trees — the small axe only knows dead wood.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Open a clearing in my grove. Listen how the song changes where light falls.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Every good line needs its silence. Cut me one.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I watch the fungi of this valley. They are never in a hurry.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: What you see is only the fruit. The fungus lives hidden, as threads, underground.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Six kinds grow here. I need four, the rest only if you like. Take my knife and my basket.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Don't force it: cut, don't pull. Brush, don't wash.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Four is enough. Whoever knows what is enough has everything.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Be like water: soft, and still it wears down stone.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The others only if you like. Just never eat the red one.

radiationSuitAll.speaker: npc
radiationSuitAll.text: All six! You walked with the valley, not against it.

radiationSuitAll.speaker: npc
radiationSuitAll.text: Just never eat the red one.

porcini.speaker: npc
porcini.text: West, at the end of the corridor: a brown bun on a fat stem. Just walk up to it.

morel.speaker: npc
morel.text: North, on an island: a cap like a honeycomb. Two sticks make a bridge; Bram has the axe.

puffball.speaker: npc
puffball.text: North-east, in the tall grass: a white ball with no cap. Tall grass falls to a scythe or fire.

inkCap.speaker: npc
inkCap.text: Far north, behind dry bushes: tall and white, shaggy. Dry bushes burn.

chanterelle.speaker: npc
chanterelle.text: North, ringed by lava: a golden funnel. A stone sinks and becomes floor. Lava lights a stick.

flyAgaric.speaker: npc
flyAgaric.text: The north-west corner, behind dead scrub: red, with white spots. Bring an axe. Don't eat.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Everything I paint comes out grey. Colour doesn't come ready-made: we draw it from the ground.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Take the shovel: dig four holes, close by.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Your painting stays here.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The world had no colour. Now it does, because we made it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: If I had to live it all again, the grey too, I would.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I lost the business, the firewood, everything. My hands are shaking.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The rest isn't up to me. A fire is. Over there, on that dirt. Take the axe.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Cut a dead branch and bring it to the block. Stand it up and split it. Both halves go on the dirt. Four times.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Dead trees are rare around here. Walk and look.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I can still smell the smoke.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: It isn't what happens that weighs on us. It's what we think of it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Thank you, friend. The axe is yours.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: My telescope broke in the fall. Only the tube is left.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: No tripod, no lens, no sky. And everyone is born wanting to know.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Take this pickaxe. Bring me an iron bar.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The sky is still up there. Looking at it is the best of life. Come back at night.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I built a cairn here: a place to come back to.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: One swallow doesn't make a summer: happiness is a whole life, not a day.

ore.speaker: npc
ore.text: Head west, to the lava lake. The black-veined rock gives charcoal, the red-veined one, ore. The furnace here asks for one at a time.

bloom.speaker: npc
bloom.text: Take the charcoal and the ore to the furnace, right here. It asks for what it needs, one thing at a time.

iron.speaker: npc
iron.text: Hammer the hot lump. Three blows.

dig.speaker: npc
dig.text: {n} to go. Shovel in the dirt.

seeds.speaker: npc
seeds.text: Four holes! The shovel stays here beside me.

seeds.speaker: npc
seeds.text: Mixed seeds: one in each hole.

sow.speaker: npc
sow.text: {n} to go. One seed in each hole.

bucket.speaker: npc
bucket.text: Fetch water from the pond, to the west, and water all four.

water.speaker: npc
water.text: {n} to go. Fill the bucket at the pond and water them.

wait.speaker: npc
wait.text: Take a walk around the valley. They grow little by little.

harvest.speaker: npc
harvest.text: Pick them by hand, all four. Then to the table.

bring.speaker: npc
bring.text: The flowers go on the table.

easel.speaker: npc
easel.text: Brush in hand. Paint the world you want.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: What flowers! Watch how it's done.

urucum.speaker: npc
urucum.text: Annatto: I rub the seeds in water and the red powder comes off.

anil.speaker: npc
anil.text: Indigo: the leaves ferment in water. I beat it, and the blue is born in the air.

curcuma.speaker: npc
curcuma.text: Turmeric: the root, dried and ground, becomes yellow powder.

garanca.speaker: npc
garanca.text: Madder: the ground root, in warm water. Boiled, the red turns dull.

binder.speaker: npc
binder.text: Alum fixes the colour. Gum arabic makes it paint.

brush.speaker: npc
brush.text: Thank you for the paints! I'll set up the canvas.

brush.speaker: npc
brush.text: Take the brush: now you're the one who creates.

form.sparse: A few strokes, and it says everything.
form.middle: Look what you did on this canvas!

color.all: All four colours together. Even I would not dare.
color.urucum: That orange looks like late afternoon.
color.anil: That blue looks like deep water.
color.curcuma: That yellow warms the whole canvas.

thanks.speaker: npc
thanks.text: I only saw grey. We invented colour.

thanks.speaker: npc
thanks.text: I will keep the brush. The painting stays here.

gather.speaker: npc
gather.text: {n} to go. Dead branch, block, dirt. Dead trees are rare: search.

ready.speaker: npc
ready.text: Four. That's a fire already, it only lacks the flame.

split.rough: Split crooked, but split. You learn an axe by swinging it.

fire.worked: That fire took work. Every fire does.

story.speaker: npc
story.text: Sit. Watch the fire with me.

story.speaker: npc
story.text: Fire is not a thing. It is a thing happening.

story.speaker: npc
story.text: Heat makes the branch give off gas. The gas burns, not the wood.

story.speaker: npc
story.text: The gas meets the air, and that burning gives off more heat. Which gives off more gas. That is why it keeps itself going.

story.speaker: npc
story.text: And this light? Soot. Tiny grains, so hot they glow.

story.speaker: npc
story.text: The tree spent its whole life storing sun. The fire only gives it back.

farewell.speaker: npc
farewell.text: I lost what was never mine. Look: my hands stopped shaking.

farewell.speaker: npc
farewell.text: Nobody can take this night from me.

tripod.speaker: npc
tripod.text: The lens is missing, and a lens is glass.

tripod.speaker: npc
tripod.text: Glass is born from sand and ash: the ash helps the sand melt.

tripod.speaker: npc
tripod.text: The ash is by the fire. Sand only by the big lake, down south. Both into the furnace.

wait.speaker: npc
wait.text: Sand from the big lake, down south. Ash from the fire. Both into the furnace.

polish.speaker: npc
polish.text: Good glass. Now it becomes a lens.

polish.speaker: npc
polish.text: First the rough stone, for the curve. Then the fine one, to clear the haze.

carry.speaker: npc
carry.text: Take the telescope to the plateau, to the south-west. Climb the stairs and look for the cairn. The sky is cleaner up there.

night.speaker: npc
night.text: You can't see anything by day.

night.speaker: npc
night.text: Sit beside it and wait for the night.

reunion.speaker: npc
reunion.text: I saw the fire from up there. Any marshmallows left?

goodbye.speaker: npc
goodbye.text: With the sky back, my ship found me.

goodbye.speaker: npc
goodbye.text: But I have to go back to my home planet. Home is up there.

goodbye.speaker: npc
goodbye.text: When you look at the sky, wave.

farewell.speaker: npc
farewell.text: Galileo saw this sky through a lens like that, in 1610. Nobody believed him.

farewell.speaker: npc
farewell.text: The light you saw was on its way long before you were born.

farewell.speaker: npc
farewell.text: It only needed someone to look.

controls.touchHint: Drag anywhere to walk · A talk & take · B use

cut.title: Cut
cut.aimKeys: Z when the blade is between the marks
cut.aimTouch: Tap when the blade is between the marks
cut.sawTouch: Swipe side to side to saw
cut.tooHigh: Too high. Cut close to the ground.
cut.tooHighVolva: Too high. Keep the cup at the base.
cut.tooDeep: Too deep. That tears the mycelium.
cut.mycelium: Those white threads are the fungus itself: the mycelium. Left in the soil, it fruits again.

clean.title: Clean
clean.why: Brush, don't wash: mushrooms soak up water.

puffball.curiosity: Rain does the work: every drop that hits it puffs out spores.
puffball.cut: Cut under the ball, at the base.
puffball.clean: Brush off the soil and loose spines.
notes: Old ones puff out a cloud of spores.

inkCap.curiosity: Within hours it melts into black ink. People once wrote with it.
inkCap.cut: Cut low on the slim stem. It's hollow.
inkCap.clean: Be quick: once picked, it turns to ink within hours.
notes: It melts into black ink full of spores.
Pick it young. It inks within hours.

morel.curiosity: It favors dying elms and old apple orchards.
morel.cut: Cut at the base. The whole thing is hollow.
morel.clean: Grit hides in the pits. Brush each one.
notes: Spores grow in tiny sacs, not gills.

chanterelle.curiosity: It smells of apricots, and hardly any bug will eat it.
chanterelle.cut: Cut at the base, just above the moss.
chanterelle.clean: Dirt hides in the ridges. Brush them out.

flyAgaric.curiosity: It was once crumbled into milk to kill flies. Hence the name.
flyAgaric.cut: Cut below the soil line. The cup at the base, the volva, is how amanitas are told apart.
flyAgaric.clean: Brush gently: the white warts rub off.
notes: The warts are scraps of its egg-like veil.
The cup at the base marks an amanita.

porcini.curiosity: A single one can weigh over a kilo.
porcini.cut: Cut at the base of the thick stem.
porcini.clean: Brush the cap. White pores underneath mean it's young.

toolbox.title: Build
toolbox.keysTouch: Tap to pick · tap to build
toolbox.keysTouchFurnace: Tap to pick · tap to smelt

bottle.speaker: narrator
bottle.text: “I made it. It's good here. Come.”

astronaut.speaker: npc
astronaut.text: The porch has the best view after the ship. Sit there.

businessMan.speaker: npc
businessMan.text: The door sticks. The porch does not.

painter.speaker: npc
painter.text: Everything in here is wet with paint.

painter.speaker: npc
painter.text: Sit on the porch. I'll bring tea.

radiationSuit.speaker: npc
radiationSuit.text: Better stay out. There is fungus on everything.

radiationSuit.speaker: npc
radiationSuit.text: The porch is yours. I'll bring tea.

sword.speaker: narrator
sword.text: And gave the world back its light.

visit.speaker: npc
visit.text: Don't get up. I didn't come for you.

visit.speaker: npc
visit.text: I know you. I walked behind you the whole war.

visit.speaker: npc
visit.text: You were a warrior. Wherever you went, I had work.

visit.speaker: npc
visit.text: Now you sleep by a fire, and your sword stayed on the road.

visit.speaker: npc
visit.text: Without the war, what is left of you? Nothing means anything. It never did.

visit.speaker: npc
visit.text: Glory, honour, victory. I've seen what's left of them: nothing.

visit.speaker: npc
visit.text: Sleep. I know how to wait.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The marshmallow turns golden.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The sword stays in the road.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Friends, fire, food. Nothing is missing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nowhere to be. At last.

moon.name: The Moon
moon.seen: Each bright spot is a crater. The dark ones are seas of old lava.
moon.fact: Its light takes 1.3 seconds to get here.

jupiter.name: Jupiter
jupiter.seen: Four little dots in a row beside it. They are moons.
jupiter.fact: Galileo saw them in 1610: not everything circles the Earth.

saturn.name: Saturn
saturn.seen: The rings are not one piece.
saturn.fact: They are billions of bits of ice and rock, each on its own orbit.

pleiades.name: The Pleiades
pleiades.seen: To the naked eye, a smudge. Through the lens, dozens of stars.
pleiades.fact: That light left there some 440 years ago.

key.speaker: npc
key.text: You have shown yourself a true friend to everyone: the village and nature alike.

key.speaker: npc
key.text: Now you may walk freely through the High Garden, with respect for nature.
